title: Pet-Friendly Hotels in Detroit and Ann Arbor, Michigan | PetTripFinder
meta_description: Verified pet-friendly hotels across Detroit, Dearborn, DTW airport, Oakland County suburbs, and Ann Arbor, with real pet fees and policies read from each hotel's own official website.
introductory_copy: Every listing links to a pet policy verified directly from the hotel's own official website.
_boundary_note: PTF-DETROIT-ANN-ARBOR-MARKET-FACTORY-001 Phase 1 visitor market, not the municipal line and not the full CSA. Two intentional travel cores: DETROIT METRO (Downtown/Midtown/Corktown Detroit; Dearborn/Henry Ford; DTW/Romulus/Belleville; Southfield; Troy/Auburn Hills; Birmingham/Royal Oak/Rochester/Pontiac; Novi/Wixom; Farmington Hills/West Bloomfield; Livonia/Plymouth/Northville) and ANN ARBOR / WASHTENAW (Ann Arbor core+campus+Research Park/State St, collapsed into one corridor -- see below; Ypsilanti/eastern Washtenaw). EXCLUDED as boundary decisions: all of Macomb County (Sterling Heights, Utica, Chesterfield Township, Shelby Township -- named in Visit Detroit's own Detroit Hotel Guide but outside this work order's named hypothesis clusters); Saline and Chelsea (western Washtenaw outer ring, Destination Ann Arbor 'surrounding destinations' pages but not a named hypothesis corridor); Manchester, Milan, Dexter (no lodging discovered); Flint, Livingston County/Brighton/Howell, Monroe, Toledo/OH, Port Huron, Lansing direction (never absorbed). Ann Arbor core (downtown/campus) and Ann Arbor south (US-23/State St/Research Park/Briarwood) were tested as SEPARATE hypothesis corridors per the work order, but no discovery source gave ZIP-level data precise enough to split individual hotels between them without fabricating a boundary; they are collapsed into one 'ann-arbor' corridor pending that identity recovery -- recorded honestly rather than guessed. This market publishes nothing in this work order.
